verified_questions.q: How many entities are in the Technology sector?
verified_questions.sparql: SELECT (COUNT(?entity) AS ?count) WHERE { ?entity a adop:Entity ; adop:belongsToSector ?sector . ?sector adop:sectorName "Technology" }

verified_questions.q: List 5 entities listed on NASDAQ with their tickers
verified_questions.sparql: SELECT ?entityName ?ticker WHERE { ?entity a adop:Entity ; adop:entityName ?entityName ; adop:ticker ?ticker ; adop:listedOn ?ex . ?ex adop:exchangeCode "NASDAQ" } LIMIT 5

known_followups: Smoke Lambda (adop-semantic-smoke) is used by the agent's execute_sparql tool — keep it (do not delete). It is the in-VPC SPARQL forwarder for the AgentCore runtime which lives outside the VPC.
DataLake KMS access was patched inline on the OntopTaskRole post-deploy. CDK has been updated to match — next cdk deploy will preserve the policy.

The agent execution role IAM policy AdopSemanticAgentAccess and the OpenSearch data-access policy adop-semantic-access were both updated post-deploy. Next iteration of CDK should encode these so a fresh deploy gets them automatically.

OBQC's _extract_select_variables was patched to skip variables inside aggregate functions (COUNT/SUM/MIN/MAX/AVG/SAMPLE/GROUP_CONCAT). Update lambdas/obqc/handler.py is the canonical source going forward.
